name: byte8/module-compliance
description: EU consumer-compliance toolkit for Magento 2. First feature: the EU legal-guarantee (statutory warranty) notice with the official harmonised label on product, cart and checkout pages — mandatory in the EU from 27 Sep 2026 (EmpCo).

suggest.swissup/firecheckout: The module ships a ready-made firecheckout_index_index layout; on plain Luma checkout the standard checkout_index_index layout is used instead.
